data.name: Vihaan
data.gender_notes: Vihaan is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Often derived from the Sanskrit vi, 'apart', + han, 'to strike' — 'dawn, the breaking of day'. Its root is Sanskrit vi + han. A modern popular Indian given name. Vihaan is a Sanskrit name meaning “Dawn; morning; first light”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vihaan expresses “Dawn; morning; first light”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Often derived from the Sanskrit vi, 'apart', + han, 'to strike' — 'dawn, the breaking of day'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vihaan total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
